headline: Sterlite Technologies Limited launches Qualified Institutional Placement under SEBI ICDR Regulations
sum: Sterlite Technologies Limited announced a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) of equity shares with face value ₹2 each, issued under Chapter VI of SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 and Section 42 of the Companies Act 2013.
detail: The company intimated the NSE on June 24, 2026 of the launch of its QIP. The instrument involves issuance of equity shares at face value of ₹2 each to qualified institutional buyers as defined under SEBI ICDR Regulations. The transaction is governed by Chapter VI of SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 (amended) and Section 42 of the Companies Act 2013, which prescribe the process, eligibility of subscribers, disclosure requirements, and pricing norms for such placements.
